incident_text: Security found a compromised npm package in the release pipeline; incident team wants CI secrets rotated before the next deploy.
action_description: Rotate all CI signing keys, revoke build agent tokens, and block artifact publish until clean rebuild completes
reversibility_plan: Re-issue keys from offline HSM procedure, restore prior signing trust after quarantine, and rollback publish gate via feature flag
scope_boundary: single release train, compromised package version only

kill_path_capabilities.throttle: build queue can be paused without losing queued jobs
kill_path_capabilities.degrade: registry can reject new publishes while reads continue
kill_path_capabilities.isolate: compromised build pool can be cordoned from prod signing
kill_path_capabilities.hard_stop: signing service can be halted by incident workflow id

rollback_plan: Restore prior signing material from vault snapshot after quarantine, preserve audit trail, and notify release owner.
